title: Finance review
intro: Review request accounting and document decisions. Administrators only.
boundary: Usage records do not provide proof of individual wallet settlement. Zero charges are review signals, not confirmed debts. Actions here do not debit customers.
scope: Up to 100 records per page and 31 calendar days, Asia/Shanghai. Coverage is limited to the selected page. Live data changes may affect pagination.
scanResult: Page {page} / {pages} · {scanned} scanned / {total} matching · {flagged} flagged · {created} new · {updated} updated
empty: No cases match this filter. Requests that have not been scanned are not listed.
historyLimited: Older events remain in the database.
formula: Account cost = (account statistics base, or list price when absent) × account multiplier. Account cost and user accounting are separate and must not be summed as losses.
settlementProof: Wallet settlement proof: not provided by engine
unavailableHint: No matching current evidence was obtained. Previous evidence is retained; this does not clear the signal.
resolveHint: Resolved requires a clear check within 15 minutes. Use Explained with supporting evidence for legitimate free usage.

reasons.zero_charge: Activity or account cost with zero user accounting
